// Run this program with go run -mod=readonly from an unchanged Orka checkout at
// 1cd16c88b43410e0ea46463f8a39b473d8e5250e. Copy it to a temporary .go file first.
// The resolved input structs and ordering match resolvedClassProfileHash in
// internal/controller/execution_workspace_class_controller.go at that commit.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"time"

	acpv1 "github.com/orka-agents/orka/api/acp.workspace/v1alpha1"
	fakev1 "github.com/orka-agents/orka/api/fake.workspace/v1alpha1"
	workspacev1 "github.com/orka-agents/orka/api/workspace/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/orka-agents/orka/pkg/workspaceprovider"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
)

type fixture struct {
	Name           string                                 `json:"name"`
	Class          workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceClass    `json:"class"`
	Provider       workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceProvider `json:"provider"`
	ProviderConfig any                                    `json:"providerConfig"`
	Pool           *workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspacePool    `json:"pool,omitempty"`
	Parameters     any                                    `json:"parameters"`
	Resolved       []json.RawMessage                      `json:"resolved"`
	Hash           string                                 `json:"hash"`
}

func main() {
	cases := []struct {
		name       string
		backend    acpv1.RuntimeProviderBackend
		profile    acpv1.RuntimeWorkspaceProfileSpec
		pooled     bool
		suspension bool
	}{
		{name: "fake-direct"},
		{name: "fake-pool", pooled: true},
		{name: "agent-sandbox-default", backend: acpv1.RuntimeProviderBackendAgentSandbox},
		{name: "agent-sandbox-durable", backend: acpv1.RuntimeProviderBackendAgentSandbox, suspension: true,
			profile: acpv1.RuntimeWorkspaceProfileSpec{AgentSandbox: &acpv1.AgentSandboxProfileSpec{Suspend: &acpv1.AgentSandboxSuspendPolicy{
				Mode:   acpv1.SubstrateSuspendModeDataOnly,
				Volume: acpv1.AgentSandboxDurableVolume{Capacity: "1Gi"},
			}}}},
		{name: "substrate-default", backend: acpv1.RuntimeProviderBackendSubstrate,
			profile: acpv1.RuntimeWorkspaceProfileSpec{Substrate: &acpv1.SubstrateProfileSpec{
				TemplateRef: acpv1.SubstrateTemplateReference{Name: "runtime"},
			}}},
		{name: "substrate-data-only", backend: acpv1.RuntimeProviderBackendSubstrate, suspension: true,
			profile: acpv1.RuntimeWorkspaceProfileSpec{Substrate: &acpv1.SubstrateProfileSpec{
				TemplateRef: acpv1.SubstrateTemplateReference{Name: "runtime", Namespace: "infrastructure"},
				Suspend:     &acpv1.SubstrateSuspendPolicy{Mode: acpv1.SubstrateSuspendModeDataOnly},
			}}},
	}
	var fixtures []fixture
	for _, c := range cases {
		provider := workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceProvider{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: c.name, UID: types.UID(c.name + "-provider-uid"), Generation: 1},
			Spec: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceProviderSpec{
				ControllerName:    "fake.workspace.orka.ai/v1",
				ParametersRef:     workspacev1.TypedObjectReference{Group: "fake.workspace.orka.ai", Kind: "FakeProviderConfig", Name: "default"},
				LifecycleState:    workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceProviderActive,
				RequiredContracts: []string{workspacev1.ContractVersionV1},
			},
		}
		class := workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceClass{
			ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: c.name, Namespace: "workspaces", UID: types.UID(c.name + "-class-uid"), Generation: 1},
			Spec: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceClassSpec{
				ProviderRef:        &workspacev1.ClusterObjectReference{Name: provider.Name},
				ParametersRef:      &workspacev1.TypedObjectReference{Group: "fake.workspace.orka.ai", Kind: "FakePoolParameters", Name: "profile"},
				Mode:               workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceModeInteractive,
				RequiredFeatures:   []workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceFeature{workspacev1.WorkspaceFeatureTLS, workspacev1.WorkspaceFeatureExec},
				AllowedReuseScopes: []workspacev1.WorkspaceReuseScope{workspacev1.WorkspaceReuseScopeSession, workspacev1.WorkspaceReuseScopeNone},
				Lifecycle: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceLifecycle{
					DefaultOnDetach: workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetachDelete,
					AllowedOnDetach: []workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetach{workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetachDelete},
					DetachTimeout:   metav1.Duration{Duration: 2 * time.Minute},
					DeletionPolicy: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspaceDeletionPolicy{
						ProviderResources: workspacev1.WorkspaceDeletionActionDelete,
						PersistentVolumes: workspacev1.WorkspaceDeletionActionDelete,
						Checkpoints:       workspacev1.WorkspaceDeletionActionDelete,
					},
				},
			},
		}
		meta := metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "profile", Namespace: "workspaces", UID: types.UID(c.name + "-parameters-uid"), Generation: 7}
		configMeta := metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "default", UID: types.UID(c.name + "-config-uid"), Generation: 1}
		var parameters any = &fakev1.FakePoolParameters{
			TypeMeta: metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: fakev1.GroupVersion.String(), Kind: "FakePoolParameters"}, ObjectMeta: meta,
		}
		var config any = &fakev1.FakeProviderConfig{
			TypeMeta: metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: fakev1.GroupVersion.String(), Kind: "FakeProviderConfig"}, ObjectMeta: configMeta,
		}
		if c.backend != "" {
			provider.Spec.ControllerName = "acp.workspace.orka.ai/runtime-pool"
			provider.Spec.ParametersRef = workspacev1.TypedObjectReference{Group: acpv1.GroupVersion.Group, Kind: "RuntimeProviderConfig", Name: "default"}
			class.Spec.ParametersRef = &workspacev1.TypedObjectReference{Group: acpv1.GroupVersion.Group, Kind: "RuntimeWorkspaceProfile", Name: "profile"}
			parameters = &acpv1.RuntimeWorkspaceProfile{TypeMeta: metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: acpv1.GroupVersion.String(), Kind: "RuntimeWorkspaceProfile"}, ObjectMeta: meta, Spec: c.profile}
			config = &acpv1.RuntimeProviderConfig{TypeMeta: metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: acpv1.GroupVersion.String(), Kind: "RuntimeProviderConfig"}, ObjectMeta: configMeta, Spec: acpv1.RuntimeProviderConfigSpec{Backend: c.backend}}
		}
		if c.suspension {
			class.Spec.Lifecycle.DefaultOnDetach = workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetachSuspend
			class.Spec.Lifecycle.AllowedOnDetach = []workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetach{workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetachSuspend, workspacev1.WorkspaceOnDetachDelete}
			class.Spec.Lifecycle.MaxLifetime = &metav1.Duration{Duration: 24 * time.Hour}
		}
		var pool *workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspacePool
		if c.pooled {
			pool = &workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspacePool{
				ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "pool", Namespace: "workspaces", UID: "pool-uid", Generation: 2},
				Spec: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspacePoolSpec{
					ProviderRef: *class.Spec.ProviderRef, ParametersRef: *class.Spec.ParametersRef,
					Capacity: workspacev1.ExecutionWorkspacePoolCapacity{MinReady: 1, MaxSize: 5},
				},
			}
			class.Spec.ProviderRef, class.Spec.ParametersRef = nil, nil
			class.Spec.PoolRef = &corev1.LocalObjectReference{Name: pool.Name}
		}
		requiredContracts := append([]string(nil), provider.Spec.RequiredContracts...)
		slices.Sort(requiredContracts)
		identity := struct {
			UID               types.UID                        `json:"uid"`
			ControllerName    string                           `json:"controllerName"`
			ParametersRef     workspacev1.TypedObjectReference `json:"parametersRef"`
			RequiredContracts []string                         `json:"requiredContracts"`
		}{provider.UID, provider.Spec.ControllerName, provider.Spec.ParametersRef, requiredContracts}
		object, err := runtime.DefaultUnstructuredConverter.ToUnstructured(parameters)
		must(err)
		var resolved any
		if pool == nil {
			resolved = struct {
				APIVersion string    `json:"apiVersion"`
				Kind       string    `json:"kind"`
				UID        types.UID `json:"uid"`
				Generation int64     `json:"generation"`
				Spec       any       `json:"spec,omitempty"`
			}{object["apiVersion"].(string), object["kind"].(string), meta.UID, meta.Generation, object["spec"]}
		} else {
			resolved = struct {
				UID           types.UID                          `json:"uid"`
				ProviderRef   workspacev1.ClusterObjectReference `json:"providerRef"`
				ParametersRef workspacev1.TypedObjectReference   `json:"parametersRef"`
				ParameterUID  types.UID                          `json:"parameterUID"`
				Generation    int64                              `json:"parameterGeneration"`
				Spec          any                                `json:"parameterSpec,omitempty"`
			}{pool.UID, pool.Spec.ProviderRef, pool.Spec.ParametersRef, meta.UID, meta.Generation, object["spec"]}
		}
		hash, err := workspaceprovider.ClassProfileHash(class.Spec, identity, resolved)
		must(err)
		fixtures = append(fixtures, fixture{c.name, class, provider, config, pool, parameters, []json.RawMessage{raw(identity), raw(resolved)}, hash})
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(encoder.Encode(struct {
		Baseline string    `json:"baseline"`
		Fixtures []fixture `json:"fixtures"`
	}{"1cd16c88b43410e0ea46463f8a39b473d8e5250e", fixtures}))
}

func raw(value any) json.RawMessage { data, err := json.Marshal(value); must(err); return data }
func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
